## Summary

Describe the root cause and the focused change that addresses it.

## User-visible impact

Explain behavior, documentation, compatibility, or migration effects. Write `None` when there are none.

## Verification

- [ ] Type check
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Build
- [ ] Browser E2E, when applicable
- [ ] Package dry run, when applicable

List the exact commands executed and any checks that were not applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I added or updated regression coverage for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated English and Chinese documentation for public contract changes.
- [ ] I did not include generated output, credentials, signed URLs, or private media.
- [ ] I reviewed public API, security, and release implications.
